description: Update the company info of a domain.

inputSchema.description: At least one field besides `domain_id` must be provided. Fields left out are unchanged.

domain_id.description: Domain ID, as returned by list-domains. Required unless the legacy sending_domain_id is given.

info_level.description: Whether the sender is a business or an individual.

privacy_policy_url.description: URL of the privacy policy page.

terms_of_service_url.description: URL of the terms of service page.

name: update-company-info
